feed_routes.note: Use only material records explicitly compatible with AMS lite. TPU 85A/90A guidance excludes AMS and AMS lite.

feed_routes.title: Original AMS (A1 Series AMS Hub)
feed_routes.note: Bambu lists Original AMS support on the A1 series with the A1 Series AMS Hub. Minimum A1 mini firmware: 01.06.10.33; use Bambu Studio 2.3.0 or later and select the matching AMS type in printer settings. Do not mix AMS Lite with this AMS family. Hardware support only: exact material/profile and spool fit still require review, and Alloy send remains unqualified.

spool_forms.title: Bambu filament on reusable spool
spool_forms.compatible_routes: External/direct; AMS lite only when the selected material permits it
spool_forms.geometry: 1.75 mm filament. For AMS lite, confirm 40–68 mm width and 53–58 mm inner diameter.
spool_forms.note: A compatible physical spool does not qualify an Alloy send; check material, route, dryness and tangle state.
spool_forms.source: Bambu A1 mini specifications and AMS lite guidance; reviewed 2026-09-29

spool_forms.title: Bambu filament refill
spool_forms.compatible_routes: External/direct after fitting a compatible reusable spool; AMS lite only after the assembled spool fit and material are checked
spool_forms.geometry: The refill must be installed on a reusable spool before loading.
spool_forms.note: Never place a loose refill on a holder or AMS lite. Confirm the wound filament is secure and unwinds freely.
spool_forms.source: Bambu PLA Basic/Matte/PETG product guidance; reviewed 2026-09-29

spool_forms.title: Third-party 1.75 mm spool
spool_forms.compatible_routes: External/direct only until a specific AMS lite fit is measured and reviewed
spool_forms.geometry: No universal Bambu fit claim. Inspect flange clearance, hub engagement, width, winding and free rotation.
spool_forms.note: The app records a route decision; it does not infer AMS lite fit from filament diameter alone.
spool_forms.source: Alloy safety policy; manufacturer spool dimensions required

spool_forms.title: Regular AMS-compatible spool
spool_forms.compatible_routes: Original AMS, AMS 2 Pro or AMS HT only with the A1 Series AMS Hub and compatible printer firmware; not AMS Lite
spool_forms.geometry: Check the exact spool against the selected AMS unit. AMS Lite dimensions do not apply to these enclosed AMS systems.
spool_forms.note: Hardware route availability does not confirm spool fit or material compatibility. Do not mix AMS Lite with this AMS family.

spool_guidance: External/direct feed is the initial route for every material trial; check the spool state, tangles, dryness and remaining material.
AMS lite physical-spool range: 40–68 mm width and 53–58 mm inner diameter.

Use external/direct feed as the default for TPU and PVA. Bambu lists dry PVA as AMS lite-compatible but warns against wet/absorbent PVA; consider AMS lite only when the exact spool is known dry and its material profile explicitly permits that route.
Original AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT are supported on A1 mini only with the A1 Series AMS Hub and compatible firmware; do not mix them with AMS Lite. Verify exact spool and material compatibility.

AMS Lite material routing is a separate check: Bambu lists PLA, PETG, ASA, PET, PA, PC, dry PVA/BVOH, PP, POM, HIPS and Bambu PLA-CF/PAHT-CF; specific materials are not recommended or unsupported as listed below.
AMS Lite spool size: 40–68 mm width and 53–58 mm inner diameter; this physical range does not qualify a material, printer profile or Alloy send.
